about: The Wheel of Whatever: what a chance space can do, and the Fair Bulletins read out at the start of each round (round 5). `w` is the weight. `do` is read by js/sim/board.js spin(); `{p}` is the player who landed, `{o}` another player picked at random. A bulletin's `mods` are explained at LAST_CALL in board.js.

events.text: {p} found a roll of tickets under the bench. +5 tickets!
{p} dropped their popcorn AND their tickets. -4 tickets.
Free samples! Everyone gets 2 tickets.
{p} wins the ring toss and {o} pays up. {p} takes 3 tickets from {o}.
{p} feels generous and hands {o} 3 tickets.
The crowd sweeps {p} along. Forward 3 spaces!
{p} took a wrong turn at the candy floss. Back 2 spaces.
A magician's trick! {p} and {o} swap places.
The ticket inspector checks whoever has the most. They hand 4 tickets to {p}.
Grand prize! {p} wins a ribbon outright!
{p} finds a golden die in the hay! Next roll uses two dice.
{p} steps in candy floss. Sticky shoes: next roll is only 1 to 3.
{p} whacks a piñata! {p} grabs 4 tickets, everyone else scrambles for 1.
{p} dresses up as the ticket collector. Everyone with more than 10 tickets pays 2.
Lost and found! Whoever has the fewest tickets gets 5. That's {o}.
A pony ride carries {p} all the way to the next prize booth!
The carousel spins too fast! Everyone is flung 2 spaces forward.
{p} bets 5 tickets on a coin flip...
The fog machine goes off! When it clears, everyone is somewhere else.
{p} wins a balloon animal. +2 tickets and a big smile.
A seagull swoops off with {p}'s tickets! -3.
Raffle time! The lucky number belongs to {o}, who wins a ribbon!
{p} left their coat at the gate and runs back for it. (+5 for passing the gate.)
{p} gets their face painted as a tiger. Roar! +1 ticket.
{p} buys everyone candy floss: 1 ticket each from {p}'s pocket.
{p} and {o} drop their ticket rolls in a puddle and pick up the wrong ones. They swap tickets!
{p} rings the strongman bell. {o} lost the bet and pays 2 tickets.

bulletins.title: Ribbon Sale!
bulletins.text: Prize ribbons cost only 7 tickets this round.

bulletins.title: Mud Season
bulletins.text: The puddles are deeper: they cost 5 tickets this round.

bulletins.title: The Parade Passes!
bulletins.text: Everyone dances 2 spaces forward with the band.

bulletins.title: Double Prize Day
bulletins.text: This round's minigame pays double tickets!

bulletins.title: Piñata Party!
bulletins.text: A giant piñata bursts over the fair. Everyone grabs a handful of tickets.

bulletins.title: Underdog Hour
bulletins.text: Whoever is in last place gets a golden die (two dice next roll).

bulletins.title: Golden Ducks
bulletins.text: Duck pond prizes are doubled this round.

bulletins.title: Duel Day
bulletins.text: Dice duels take 6 tickets this round. Roll high!

bulletins.title: A Lovely Evening
bulletins.text: Nothing unusual is happening at the fair tonight. Probably.
